errors.not_configured: Checkout is being set up. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.price_missing: This option can’t be bought yet. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.nonprod: Checkout only opens on onwardscout.com, not on this test site.
errors.has_plan: You already have Pro. Manage or cancel it from Billing.
errors.stale: That checkout attempt expired. Press the button again to start a fresh one.
errors.invalid: Pick Pro or a credit pack to continue.
errors.rate_limited: Too many checkout attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.failed: We couldn’t open checkout. Please try again in a moment.
errors.network: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.not_open: Purchases open soon. Your free credits and practice runs work in the meantime.

checkout.resumingTitle: Picking up where you left off
checkout.promptBody: You chose {name} before signing in. Nothing is charged until you confirm on Stripe’s page.
checkout.cancelledBody: Your choice is kept for 20 minutes, so the button picks up the same checkout.

errors.not_configured: Billing is being set up. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.no_customer: There’s no billing history yet. The portal opens after your first purchase.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.failed: We couldn’t open the billing portal. Please try again in a moment.
errors.network: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

page.title: Credits and plan
page.description: Stripe emails receipts to {email}. Credits show up here the moment a payment completes.

stats.availableHintIdle: Reserved when you confirm an application, spent only once it is submitted.
stats.availableHintHeld: {count, plural, one {# credit held} other {# credits held}} for applications in progress.
stats.expiringHint: {count, plural, one {# credit expires} other {# credits expire}} on {date, date, long}.
stats.expiringNone: Nothing expires in the next {days} days.
stats.planHintNone: Trial and pack credits. Pro adds {credits} credits every month.

page.trialNote: You’re using your free trial credits. They stay usable until {date, date, long}; Pro or a pack keeps your scout going after that.
page.emptyNote: You have no credits right now. Profile, matching, previews and drafts stay free; a pack or Pro lets Onward Scout submit for you.

plan.renews: Renews on {date, date, long}. Unused credits stay usable for {days} days after each month.
plan.cancelScheduled: Cancellation scheduled: Pro ends on {date, date, long}. Credits you already have stay usable until they expire.
plan.pastDue: Your last Pro payment didn’t go through. Stripe retries the card; update it in the portal to keep monthly credits coming.
plan.ended: Your Pro plan ended on {date, date, long}. Credits you still hold stay usable until they expire.
plan.portalNote: Change your card, download invoices or cancel in Stripe’s secure portal.

packs.title: Top up with a pack
packs.body: One payment, no renewal. Pack credits last {days} days and work with every channel.

lots.title: Your credits
lots.body: Each grant or purchase is a lot with its own expiry. Applications draw from the lot that expires first.

activity.title: Recent credit activity
activity.empty: No activity yet. Credits move when you confirm an application.

orders.title: Order history
orders.empty: No orders yet. Your free trial credits are a gift, not an order.
orders.footer: Receipts and invoices come from Stripe by email. Refunds follow our <link>refund policy</link>.

success.loading: Confirming your payment with Stripe and adding your credits…
success.confirmingTitle: Your bank is still confirming the payment.
success.confirmingBody: This page checks again every few seconds. Some payment methods take a moment; your credits appear here the second it clears.
success.confirmingLeave: It’s safe to leave: your credits arrive on their own once the payment clears, and we double-check every day.
success.bodyPlan: {credits} credits are ready now, and {credits} more arrive at the start of every billing month. Automatic follow-ups and the weekly brief are on.
success.bodyPack: {name} {credits, plural, one {is} other {are}} in your account, ready for your next application.
success.balanceHintHeld: {count, plural, one {# credit held} other {# credits held}} for applications in progress.
success.receipt: Stripe emails your receipt to the address you used at checkout.
success.manage: Manage or cancel Pro any time from Billing.
success.otherTitle: This checkout belongs to a different account.
success.otherBody: Credits go to the account that started the purchase. Sign in with the email you used at checkout, or write to <mail>{email}</mail> if this looks wrong.
success.errorTitle: We couldn’t confirm that checkout yet.
success.errorBody: If you were charged, your credits still arrive: Stripe tells us about every payment and we check again every day. Nothing after ten minutes? Write to <mail>{email}</mail> and mention reference {ref}.
success.mismatchTitle: Something doesn’t add up with this checkout.
success.mismatchBody: We’ve been alerted and are looking at it now. If you paid, you won’t lose anything: write to <mail>{email}</mail> and mention reference {ref}.
success.expiredBody: Nothing was charged. Start again from pricing whenever you like.
success.rateTitle: Too many checks in a row.
success.rateBody: Wait a few minutes and open this page again. If you paid, your credits still arrive on their own.

notifications.planStartedBody: Your first Pro month is paid. These credits stay usable until {date, date, long}.
notifications.renewedBody: Your Pro month renewed. The new credits stay usable until {date, date, long}.
notifications.packBody: Your credit pack is in. These credits stay usable until {date, date, long}.
notifications.refundedBody: {count, plural, =0 {The refund went through; that purchase had no unspent credits left.} one {The refund went through and the # unspent credit from that purchase was removed.} other {The refund went through and the # unspent credits from that purchase were removed.}} Applications already submitted are not affected.
notifications.disputedTitle: Credits paused during a card dispute
notifications.disputedBody: Your bank opened a dispute on a payment, so {count, plural, =0 {nothing changed in your balance} one {# unspent credit is paused} other {# unspent credits are paused}} until it is resolved. If this is a mistake, write to us from the contact page.
notifications.reinstatedBody: The dispute closed in your favour: {count, plural, =0 {your purchase is settled} one {# credit is back in your balance} other {# credits are back in your balance}}.
notifications.paymentFailedTitle: Your Pro payment didn’t go through
notifications.paymentFailedBody: Stripe will retry the card over the next few days. Update it from Billing to keep your monthly credits coming.
